evidence.detail: The enum contains exactly ALWAYS, RESIZING and NEVER.
R354 LauncherWindowFrame stores this enum and uses it to decide when setLocation/setBounds and width-change paths clamp geometry to the active GraphicsConfiguration bounds.
The enum owns no display text or unrelated state; its sole role is controlling when launcher-window bounds constraints are applied.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for LauncherWindowFrame's monitor-bounds constraint policy.
